events.name: China CPI (Y-o-Y)
events.description: Tracks the year-on-year change in Chinese consumer prices, signalling domestic demand strength and deflation risk.

events.name: China PPI (Y-o-Y)
events.description: Measures year-on-year factory-gate price changes in China, reflecting industrial demand and manufacturer margin pressure.

events.name: Australia RBA Interest Rate Decision
events.description: Sets Australia's benchmark cash rate, guiding borrowing costs and signalling the central bank's inflation and growth outlook.

events.name: US NFIB Small Business Optimism Index
events.description: Surveys small US business owners on hiring, sales and pricing plans, an early gauge of Main Street confidence.

events.name: US CPI (Y-o-Y)
events.description: Tracks the year-on-year change in prices US consumers pay, the Fed's key gauge for setting interest rate policy.

events.name: Germany ZEW Economic Sentiment
events.description: Surveys financial analysts on Germany's economic outlook six months ahead, an early forward-looking gauge for the Eurozone.

events.name: UK GDP (Q-o-Q)
events.description: Preliminary estimate of the quarterly change in UK economic output, the broadest gauge of growth momentum.

events.name: US Initial Jobless Claims
events.description: Counts new US unemployment benefit filings each week, an early and timely signal of labour market health.

events.name: Eurozone GDP (Q-o-Q)
events.description: Second estimate of quarterly Eurozone economic output growth, confirming or revising the earlier flash reading.

events.name: US Retail Sales (M-o-M)
events.description: Tracks the monthly change in US consumer spending at retailers, a key driver of economic growth.
